name: threadline-cli
description: Portable agent runtime manager for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Kimi, and any CLI. Multi-runtime skills, project detection, RAG indexing, and Obsidian handoffs.

scripts.check: node --check bin/threadline && node --check src/cli.mjs && node --check src/cli-plain.mjs && node --check src/core/detect-project.mjs && node --check src/core/execute.mjs && node --check src/core/paths.mjs && node --check src/core/plan.mjs && node --check src/core/skill-install.mjs && node --check src/core/skills.mjs && node --check src/core/templates.mjs && node --check src/core/watch.mjs && node --check src/utils/git.mjs
scripts.smoke: node bin/threadline detect --path examples/fullstack-js --json && node bin/threadline skills list && node bin/threadline skills recommend --path examples/fullstack-js && node bin/threadline setup --dry-run --runtimes claude,codex && node bin/threadline setup --adopt --dry-run --runtimes claude,codex && node bin/threadline setup --replace --dry-run --runtimes codex && node bin/threadline init --path examples/fullstack-js --dry-run && node bin/threadline index --path examples/fullstack-js --dry-run

author: Farhan Mansuri <mansurifarhanfm@gmail.com>
